title: Container image unpinned or using latest tag
description: Images should use an immutable digest or pinned semantic version tag rather than :latest or no tag.
remediation: Pin container image tags to a specific immutable semantic release or SHA-256 digest.

title: Container missing resource requests or limits
description: Resource limits and requests are required to enable predictable QoS and fair node sharing.
remediation: Define both resources.requests and resources.limits for cpu and memory in container spec.

title: Container missing liveness or readiness probe
description: Readiness probes prevent unhealthy pods from receiving traffic; liveness probes trigger restarts on deadlocks.
remediation: Specify readinessProbe and livenessProbe for web/service-facing containers.

title: Privileged container execution prohibited
description: Privileged containers share root access with the host kernel and bypass container isolation.
remediation: Set securityContext.privileged: false on all containers.

title: Privilege escalation allowed in container
description: Allowing privilege escalation allows child processes to gain more privileges than their parent.

title: Service missing pod selector
description: Services without selectors do not route traffic to Pods unless custom Endpoints are manually configured.
remediation: Specify spec.selector matching the target deployment pod template labels.

title: Dangerous Linux capability CAP_SYS_ADMIN added
description: CAP_SYS_ADMIN grants near-root capabilities inside the container namespace.

title: Capabilities drop absent or does not include ALL
description: Least privilege mandates dropping all default Linux capabilities before adding specific required ones.

title: Host network namespace shared
description: hostNetwork: true exposes host network interfaces and allows sniffing loopback traffic.
remediation: Remove hostNetwork: true or set it to false.

title: Host PID namespace shared
description: hostPID: true allows inspecting and signaling host processes outside the container.
remediation: Remove hostPID: true or set it to false.

title: Host IPC namespace shared
description: hostIPC: true allows accessing host shared memory mechanisms.
remediation: Remove hostIPC: true or set it to false.

title: Host path volume mount security analysis
description: hostPath volume mounts expose the underlying host filesystem directly to the container.
remediation: Replace hostPath volumes with persistent volume claims (PVC) or emptyDir.

title: Root user execution or configuration conflict
description: Containers should run as a non-root user to mitigate potential escape vulnerabilities.
remediation: Specify securityContext.runAsNonRoot: true and provide a non-zero runAsUser.

title: Read-only root filesystem not enforced
description: An immutable root filesystem prevents attackers from writing malicious binaries to disk.
remediation: Set securityContext.readOnlyRootFilesystem: true and mount writable state to tmpfs.

title: Seccomp confinement disabled (Unconfined)
description: Disabling seccomp profile allows arbitrary syscall execution.

title: Wildcard permissions in RBAC role rules
description: Wildcards ('*') in verbs or resources violate the principle of least privilege.
remediation: Enumerate explicit verbs (get, list, watch) and resource names.

title: Dangerous ClusterRoleBinding targets
description: Binding cluster-admin role to default service accounts or wide groups introduces privilege escalation.
remediation: Restrict cluster-admin bindings to dedicated administrative subjects.

title: Secret reference contains disallowed 'namespace' field
description: Secret references in container volume mounts cannot cross namespace boundaries.
remediation: Remove namespace property from secret volume source specification.

title: Literal sensitive value in container environment variable
description: Plaintext secret values or credentials stored in env.value are exposed in manifests.
remediation: Reference credentials via secretKeyRef or configMapKeyRef.
